profile.title: Tell us about your business
profile.body: Share your website or Instagram and we'll fill in what we can. Check everything before you continue.

goals.title: What do you want help with first?
goals.body: Pick as many as you like. We'll suggest automations that match.

knowledge.title: Teach your AI employee
knowledge.body: A few answers in your own words. The AI only says what you confirm here, and passes anything else to your team.

channels.title: Where do your customers message you?
channels.body: Connect any mix of channels. Every conversation lands in one inbox.

services.title: Services, team and calendar
services.body: What customers can book, who does the work, and which calendar to keep free.

employee.title: Create your AI employee
employee.body: Your AI employee drafts replies and bookings for your team to approve. Prefer to start without one? That's fine too.

compliance.title: Stay on the right side of the rules
compliance.body: We've prepared wording that fits {law}. Check it and make it yours.

launch.title: Test, then go live
launch.body: Try your AI employee on real-looking questions, send yourself a test, and choose who steps in when the AI can't help.
launch.manualBody: Send yourself a test message, check the list, and go live. Your team handles every reply.

errors.url: Enter a full link starting with https://

warm.name: Warm
warm.example: "Hi! Lovely to hear from you. Let me check that for you."

professional.name: Professional
professional.example: "Good afternoon. Thank you for your message. Here are the details."

playful.name: Playful
playful.example: "Hey there! Ooh, great choice. Let's get you sorted."

import.title: Start from your website or Instagram
import.body: We'll read your public page for your name, hours, services and common questions. Nothing is used until you confirm it.
import.label: Website or Instagram link

found.website: Here's what we found on your website
found.instagram: Here's what we found on your Instagram
found.google: Here's what we found on your Google profile

import.foundServices: {count, plural, =0 {No services} one {# service} other {# services}}
import.foundFaqs: {count, plural, =0 {No questions} one {# common question} other {# common questions}}
import.confirmLater: Prices and answers stay unconfirmed until you check them in the next steps.

errors.unreachable: We couldn't open that page. Check the link, or fill in the details below.
errors.invalid_link: That doesn't look like a link. Try something like yourbusiness.com.
errors.generic: We couldn't read that page right now. Fill in the details below instead.

profile.name: Business name
profile.description: What you do, in a sentence or two
profile.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Custom cakes and small chops for birthdays and weddings in Lekki.
profile.addressHint: The AI shares this when customers ask where you are.
profile.hoursBody: Used for bookings and so the AI can tell customers when you're open.
profile.languagesBody: The AI replies in the customer's language when it's one of these.

pack.title: Starter pack: {industry}
pack.body: {services, plural, one {# service} other {# services}} and {faqs, plural, one {# common question} other {# common questions}} are added for you to check. Prices stay empty until you set them.
pack.imported: Plus {services, plural, one {# service} other {# services}} and {faqs, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} from your page.

goals.note: Nothing switches on by itself. You'll review each automation after you go live.

reply_faster.title: Reply to customers faster
reply_faster.body: Answer common questions in seconds, day or night.

more_bookings.title: Get more bookings
more_bookings.body: Turn chats into appointments and cut no-shows.

collect_reviews.title: Collect more reviews
collect_reviews.body: Ask happy customers for a review at the right moment.

run_promotions.title: Run promotions
run_promotions.body: Bring back past customers with timely offers.

services.title: Services
services.body: Confirm each price. The AI never quotes a price you haven't confirmed.
services.empty: No services yet. Add what customers can book.
services.name: Service
services.noPrice: No price yet. The AI will pass price questions to your team.
services.noPriceTypical: No price yet (similar businesses charge around {price}). The AI will pass price questions to your team.
services.staffBody: Bookings are given to these people. You can invite them as team members later.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: Connect a calendar so the AI never books you when you're busy.
calendar.deferred: No calendar yet. Bookings follow your opening hours.
calendar.dialogBody: Demo only: a real build opens the provider's own permission screen.

services.bookingPageBody: Customers can book here as soon as you go live.

knowledge.continueAnyway: You can continue and come back. Going live with the AI needs every price confirmed, opening hours, your location and at least 3 confirmed answers.
knowledge.servicesBody: Check what we prepared. Confirm a price to let the AI quote it.
knowledge.interviewBody: Answer in your own words. Suggestions come from businesses like yours; use them only if they're true for you.
knowledge.faqsBody: Confirm the answers you're happy for the AI to give.

preview.title: What the AI knows
preview.faqs: {count, plural, =0 {No confirmed answers} one {# confirmed answer} other {# confirmed answers}}
preview.answers: {count, plural, =0 {No interview answers} one {# interview answer} other {# interview answers}}
preview.ready: Enough to go live. The AI hands anything else to your team.
preview.unknown: For anything not listed here, the AI says it will check and passes the chat to your team.

delivery.question: Do you deliver or come to customers?
delivery.placeholder: Areas, fees, lead time… or leave empty

never_promise.question: What should the AI never promise?

handoff.question: When should a person take over?

blurb.whatsapp: Your business number on the WhatsApp Business Platform.
blurb.webchat: A chat bubble on your booking page or website.
blurb.email: Reply to customer emails from the inbox.
blurb.sms: Text messages for reminders and quick replies.
blurb.instagram: Direct messages to your Instagram account.
blurb.voice: Answering calls is coming in a later release.

channels.summary: {count, plural, one {# channel connected.} other {# channels connected.}}
channels.noneYet: Connect at least one channel before going live.

whatsapp.body: You'll sign in with Meta and pick the number to use. It can't be in use on the WhatsApp app at the same time.
whatsapp.templatesPending: {count, plural, one {Meta is reviewing # template.} other {Meta is reviewing # templates.}} This usually takes a few minutes.
whatsapp.templatesReady: All templates approved. Reminders and follow-ups can go out.

dialog.title: Connect WhatsApp
dialog.loginBody: Sign in to Meta to link your business.
dialog.businessBody: Choose the Meta business portfolio this number belongs to.
dialog.numberBody: Add the phone number customers message.
dialog.simulated: Demo only: this stands in for Meta's own sign-up window.
dialog.portfolioHint: We'll create one if you don't have it yet.
dialog.numberHint: Meta sends a code to this number to confirm it.

email.managedBody: Works straight away. Good to start with.
email.domainBody: Send from your own address. Needs a few DNS records.
email.addRecords: Add these records at the company you bought {domain} from, then check.
email.partial: {verified} of {total} found. New records can take a few minutes to show up.

webchat.websiteBody: Paste one line of code on your site.
webchat.snippetBody: Paste this before the closing body tag on every page. Visitors must allow chat on the first screen; that records web-chat consent.

messenger.label: Facebook page
messenger.hint: Demo only: a real build lets you pick the page after signing in to Facebook.

instagram.label: Instagram handle
instagram.hint: Must be a business or creator account linked to a Facebook page.

sms.label: Sender name
sms.hint: Up to 11 letters or numbers. Some networks need it registered first.

employee.aiBody: Drafts replies and bookings. You start in Suggest mode: your team approves everything before it's sent.
employee.manualBody: Your team replies to every message. Add an AI employee whenever you're ready.
employee.nameBody: Customers always see that it's an AI assistant.
employee.name: Name
employee.previewBody: A preview. Real replies use what you taught it.

greeting.warm: Hi there! I'm {name}, the AI assistant for {business}. How can I help you today?
greeting.professional: Good day. I'm {name}, the AI assistant for {business}. How may I help you?
greeting.playful: Hey! I'm {name}, {business}'s AI assistant. What can I do for you?

employee.needsKnowledge: You skipped teaching the AI. You'll need to finish that step before going live with it.
employee.manualNote: Everything still works: the shared inbox, bookings, reminders and your booking page. Your setup checklist will offer the AI employee again later.

compliance.legalNameHint: Shown in your privacy policy and message footers.
compliance.disclosureBody: Customers are told they're talking to an AI. This can't be turned off while an AI employee is replying.
compliance.disclosureManual: You're not using an AI employee, so this is optional for now.
compliance.disclosureSwitch: Tell customers when a reply comes from the AI
compliance.consentBody: How customers agree to receive messages from you. Reminders and offers only go to people who agreed.
compliance.consentConfirm: I'll only message customers who agreed, and stop when they ask.
compliance.privacyBody: Required under {law}. Linked from your booking page and web chat.
compliance.generateBody: A simple policy based on your answers, hosted on your booking page.
compliance.ownLinkBody: Use the policy on your website.
compliance.recording: Phone calls aren't recorded. Call handling comes in a later release.
compliance.incomplete: Add your legal name, confirm consent and accept both agreements to continue.

gates.title: Ready to go live?
gates.blocking: {count, plural, one {# check left} other {# checks left}}
gates.notNeeded: Not needed without an AI employee.

sandbox.chatBody: Type anything a customer might send.
sandbox.chatPlaceholder: e.g. Do you open on Sundays?

scripts.unknown_price: Asks a price you haven't confirmed

test.title: Send yourself a test
test.body: Check a real message arrives the way customers will see it.
test.noChannel: Connect a channel first to send a test.

handoff.title: Who steps in
handoff.body: When the AI can't help, this person is alerted straight away. We'll send them a test alert.
handoff.sent: Test alert sent to {name} by {channel}. Did it arrive?

launch.suggestNote: {name} starts in Suggest mode: it drafts replies and your team approves each one. You can give it more freedom later.
launch.blocked: Some checks aren't done yet. See the list.

live.title: {business} is live
live.suggest: {name} is drafting replies for your team to approve. New messages show up in your inbox.
live.manual: Your inbox and booking page are ready. Your team handles every reply.

milestones.ai_taught: Your AI employee knows enough to go live
